Fixes #6128

Issue #6128 reported an `ArgumentOutOfRangeException` thrown from
`SelectingItemsControl.OnSelectionModelSelectionChanged` when an `AutoCompleteBox`'s
`ItemsSource` was cleared and refilled (the typical async-search pattern:
`FoundItems.Clear(); FoundItems.AddRange(items);`) and a selection was then committed.

The underlying issue — a de-synchronization of `ItemsView` and `SelectedItems` — no
longer occurs on master: the `SelectionModel` clears its ranges on source reset and
shifts them on item removal, so `SelectedItems` is always consistent with `ItemsView`
when `SelectionChanged` is raised.

This PR locks that behavior in with three regression tests (no production code changes):

### `SelectionModelTests_Multiple.CollectionChanges.SelectedItems_Does_Not_Desync_From_ItemsView_When_Source_Is_Cleared_And_Refilled`

Model-level test: selects an item, clears and refills the source collection, then
changes the selection. Verifies that the `SelectionChanged` event args enumerate
without throwing and that `SelectedItems` matches the new source contents.

### `AutoCompleteBoxTests.Does_Not_Throw_When_ItemsSource_Is_Cleared_And_Refilled_After_Selection`

End-to-end test of the async-search pattern: open the drop-down, select an item,
clear + refill the `ItemsSource`, re-open the drop-down and select again.

### `AutoCompleteBoxTests.Does_Not_Throw_When_DropDown_Closes_After_ItemsSource_Was_Cleared_And_Refilled`

Reproduces the exact stack of the issue: the drop-down is open, the source is
cleared/refilled, and the drop-down then closes. `CloseDropDown` sets
`SelectionAdapter.SelectedItem = null`, which commits a deselection on the inner
`SelectingItemsControl`'s `SelectionModel` and enumerates `Selection.SelectedItems`
while raising `SelectionChanged`.

All tests pass on current `master`.
